name: io.github.cyanheads/gutenberg-mcp-server
description: MCP server for Project Gutenberg: 78,000+ public-domain ebooks with full plain-text retrieval.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Sets the minimum log level for output (e.g., 'debug', 'info', 'warn').

environmentVariables.name: GUTENDEX_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Gutendex catalog API base URL, used for search and popularity browse when the local catalog mirror cannot answer. Leave blank for the public instance.

environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_TEXT_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Project Gutenberg content mirror serving the /cache/epub tree: book text, the bulk catalog archive, and per-book catalog records. Leave blank for gutenberg.pglaf.org.

environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_MIRROR_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to the local catalog-mirror SQLite file. Leave blank to use the per-user default that gutenberg-mcp-server mirror init builds.

environmentVariables.name: GUTENBERG_MIRROR_REFRESH_CRON
environmentVariables.description: Cron schedule for an in-process catalog-mirror refresh, e.g. 0 4 * * *; on an empty mirror the first run is the full harvest. Leave blank to disable.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: The hostname for the HTTP server.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: The port to run the HTTP server on.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_ENDPOINT_PATH
environmentVariables.description: The endpoint path for the MCP server.
